description.narrative: Building of capacity in research in Bolivia, including quality research in line with the national plan for development. The program consists of the strengthening of research management and specific research programs.

Uppbyggande av forskningskapacitet i Bolivia, inkluderandes forskning av kvalitet i linje med Bolivias utvecklingsplaner. Programmet består av stärkande av forskningsadministration/system och specifika forskningsprogram.

General objective:
Research at UMSS is a significant activity aimed primarily at contributing to the regional and national development processes through the generation of useful knowledge and analytical capacity. This activity also intends to contribute to the universal progress of scientific knowledge.
Specific objectives:
1. High quality research of regional and national interest is carried out by a robust, motivated and highly trained community of scientists; their outcomes are well recognized by their peers at the national and international scientific arena and are routinely passed on to economic and social actors through well-established mechanisms for transfer and innovation.
2. A science, technology and innovation supportive environment prevails at UMSS assisted by an efficient management system.

17 PhDs enrolled in the sandwich programme (nine women and eight men) have defended their dissertations and been employed by UMSS. In total 83 scientific articles were published in scientific journals by PhD students during the agreement period.
The research results achieved may potentially have a high impact for development and poverty reduction in Bolivia, for example in agriculture, food technology, energy, water and soil management etc.
Seven scientific master (Msc) programmes were elaborated and implemented by UMSS. The external evaluation by Swedish and Bolivian peers demonstrated that UMSS now has sufficent capacity to implement their own Msc programmes with enough quality. This means that UMSS is prepared for the next step in some of the research areas, that is, to run their own PhD programmes.
The first local PhD programme (in chemical technology) following international standards of quality assurance of research training was established by UMSS. The coordinators and supervisors within the programme are researchers who obtained their PhDs in Sweden in the former phases of Sida support. Some of the eleven PhD-students are supported by UMSS, some by the private sector.
Improved infrastructure for research, for example purchase of equipment for research laboratories within health, energy, chemical technology, etc, as well as development of ICT.
Capacity development related to innovation and impact of research results has resulted in improved regulations, guidelines and knowledge concerning intellectual property rights and patents. About 120 employees at UMSS have now obtained the capacity to submit applications to the Bolivian register for intellectual property.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
